fields.name: booking
fields.description: the booking id (date-time-designer of the first booking; it stays when the booking is changed)

fields.name: status
fields.description: pending: the slot is held and the designer has not answered; confirmed; declined by the designer (the slot is free); cancelled by the customer (the slot is free)

fields.name: styles
fields.description: the menu style names, one per service, in the order of services

fields.name: answers
fields.description: the checklist answers of the chosen services, one line each (label: words)

fields.name: booked_at
fields.description: when the booking was made or last changed (YYYY-MM-DD HH:MM)
